summary: AgriSpace AI is a smart farming web application developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. The project aims to help farmers make informed crop-rotation decisions using NASA Earth-observation and climate information. The platform combines farm-location selection, NASA POWER climate data, crop-rotation planning and an interactive learning feature called AgriQuest. Users can explore rainfall and temperature information, select their farm location, understand crop-sequence recommendations and learn how different crop choices can influence soil health, water availability and crop diversity. The main objective is to support sustainable agriculture and help farmers understand changing environmental conditions.
details:
AgriSpace AI is an intelligent agriculture platform that combines NASA satellite data, Artificial Intelligence and weather information to support smarter farming. It allows users to explore global locations through interactive 2D and 3D maps, understand rainfall, soil moisture, vegetation health and climate conditions, and receive agricultural guidance through AgriBot. It also includes a Crop Rotation Planner and AgriQuest, an educational virtual farming game.

The project benefits farmers, students and researchers by making agricultural and environmental information easier to understand. Its intended impact is to promote data-driven farming, sustainable resource management, climate-resilient agriculture and improved food security.

We developed the platform using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Three.js, Leaflet and Recharts. We used Visual Studio Code, GitHub and Vercel for development and deployment. Our data sources include NASA POWER, SMAP, MODIS, EONET and GIBS, along with OpenStreetMap.

The creativity of our project lies in combining space technology, AI, interactive maps and virtual farming in one platform. We considered data reliability, climate variability, soil conditions, crop suitability, accessibility, sustainability and global scalability while designing the project.
